Ivy N: Hi folks — first-week onboarding Q. When I try to open https://console.staging.redwood and click Admin -> Feature Flags I get a 403. I need to flip a small test flag for a demo later today. Who do I ping for staging-only access?
DevEx Bot: Welcome Ivy! Please open an access request at https://internal.redwood/access and include your Okta username + manager approval screenshot. Typical entitlements: "console-admin:staging" and "ff-operator". Staging-only grants are usually 3 business days.
Ivy N: Filed ACC-13420 (okta: ivy.n@redwood.dev) and attached manager Grant's approval.
Grant B: Hey Ivy — I can fast-track staging-only if Security is fine. Add a one-line rollback plan to the ticket (e.g., revert flag to false within 10m) and avoid prod keys.
Ivy N: Added rollback plan to the ticket: toggle demo/ivy-welcome -> wait 5m -> revert. Flag key is demo/ivy-welcome.
Security Squad: Quick reminder: don't paste tokens or creds in tickets. If your demo touches user flows, coordinate with SRE for a brief smoke window. We audit every admin grant.
Infra Team: Granted console-admin:staging and ff-operator to ivy.n@redwood.dev for 72 hours. Check Admin -> Feature Flags and confirm.
Ivy N: I can see Admin -> Feature Flags now. Created demo/ivy-welcome and toggled it to true. Ran smoke: ```bash
export REDWOOD_TOKEN=...
curl -s -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_TOKEN" https://api.staging.redwood/health | jq .status
``` returned "ok".
Grant B: Nice! Two quick tips: 1) use the demo/ prefix for ephemeral flags, 2) never reuse production flag names in staging tests.
Ivy N: Demo completed, closing ACC-13420. Huge thanks everyone :tada: 
Onboard Bot: If you need an extension, request a renewal before the grant expires. Docs / walkthrough: https://go/redwood-onboard/console-access.
